recommendation: Keep the commit as-is; it fixes the remaining FHIR-33169 semantic mismatch without reverting later work-group decisions. Do not restore the older always-RequestOrchestration wording unless FHIR-46313 is reopened or superseded.
issue_request: FHIR-33169 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested PlanDefinition/$apply semantics that remove useCarePlan and return Bundle 0..* with one Bundle per input subject.
initial_application: Historical commit e54c8a3dda applied most of the issue by removing useCarePlan and changing the return parameter to Bundle 0..*. The current source retained one stale narrative sentence from the old contained-resource result model.
additional_context: Current FHIR uses RequestOrchestration for the former RequestGroup name. Later Applied issues FHIR-46313 and FHIR-51557 intentionally refined the output semantics: FHIR-46313 allows variable request-resource Bundles instead of always requiring a RequestOrchestration wrapper, and FHIR-51557 clarifies that the plural Bundle return is encoded in a Parameters response.
reconciliation: Updated source/plandefinition/plandefinition-notes.xml to align the transient-result note with Bundle-entry semantics while preserving later R6 variability and response-format clarifications.
source_changes: source/plandefinition/plandefinition-notes.xml: changed the transient-result note from returned as contained resources to returned as entries in the result Bundle(s).

related_jiras.note: Applied R6 clarification relaxed the strict RequestOrchestration wrapper semantics and was preserved.
Applied R6 clarification explains the plural Bundle return is still returned using Parameters; no edit needed.
